name: shloka-learn-android
description: Android wrapper (Capacitor) for the Shloka learner page; bundles the verses and chant audio so it works offline

scripts.sync: npm run www && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.aab: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew clean bundleRelease
